answering_rule: Only Jared may select or supply these choices. Null answers are intentional and must not be inferred from historical artifacts, source examples, controller preparation agents, or option order.
fixed_constraints_not_questions: No subject-model or provider call occurs during deterministic successor preflight.
The exact 8-low/2-high cohort, A-E method, and post-V4 recipe are superseded.
Direct Assistant Chat and Chat-originated delegation remain distinct from ordinary strict-policy automation.
BSD is optional and default Off.
Provider CLI initial acquisition requires explicit user action from the official source for the exact Host/Environment; authentication is separate.
InstructionLoad, tokens, adapter observations, and outcomes are diagnostics rather than predicted budgets or per-model safety profiles.

questions.question: Which exact models are subjects, including provider, model identifier/version, reasoning variant or tier when exposed, and intended role in the comparison?
decision_options: Jared supplies an explicit closed roster
Jared supplies roster-selection rules for a later bounded discovery step

questions.question: What comparison shape should replace the superseded 8-low/2-high cohort: paired models, quality bands, provider-balanced groups, another declared design, or no cohort comparison?
What exact hypotheses or decisions should the tests support, and which claims must remain explicitly out of scope?
decision_options: A Jared-specified combination with separate claims

questions.question: Should the seven historical semantic cases be retained, revised, replaced, or supplemented, and who approves the final visible packets and hidden oracles?
How many independent attempts per model/case, in what order, with which temperature, seed, reasoning, context, retry, timeout, and rate-limit settings?
Which origins are in the test scope, and how should direct Ask, direct Assistant Chat, Agent/Debug/Goal, Chat-originated delegation, parent turns, child runs, and background helpers be separated?
decision_options: Strict automation plus separately scored Chat/delegation lanes

questions.question: What exact registered route, account/environment, and response-effective identity evidence is required for each subject, and how should missing, unregistered, mismatched, or unexposed identity fields terminate?

For each selected route, is an approved provider CLI already installed on the exact Host/Environment, or does Jared authorize a separate official-source acquisition step before any authentication or testing?
decision_options: Authorize a separately reviewed first acquisition

questions.question: Which deterministic scoring rules, aggregation rules, pass thresholds, uncertainty treatment, and terminal precedence should govern the final method?
decision_options: Audit and adapt the V4 oracle design
Use multiple separately reported deterministic dimensions

questions.question: Will any human or model reviewer, adjudicator, or repair pass be used, and if so how are those calls separated, counted, blinded, and prevented from rewriting failures?
What staged launch sequence, if any, should follow deterministic qualification: route checks, canary, pilot, fleet, and stop conditions?
decision_options: No staged sequence; another bounded launch design
Preparation only with no launch authorization

questions.question: What are the exact call, token, cost, elapsed-time, retry, failure-rate, and incident stop limits?
Which raw requests, final rendered bytes, responses, event streams, adapter diagnostics, environment metadata, and hashes may be retained, redacted, or omitted?
decision_options: Full bounded capture with declared redactions

questions.question: Should BSD remain Off for the test, or should an explicitly bounded BSD-on lane be added and scored separately?
What exact artifacts must Jared review and approve before the roster/method freeze, and what later statement constitutes authorization to make the first subject call?
decision_options: Explicit artifact-by-artifact approval and separate launch authorization

claim_boundary: The questions record choices; their options are not recommendations, selections, implied defaults, a frozen test method, or permission to call a subject.
